name: Marketing Essentials
description: Three hard-working marketing sections every website needs: a hero with a clear value-prop, a 3-up features grid, and a call-to-action banner. Token-driven CSS — drops into any theme. Vincia's parser auto-exports these to the preset library so the Composer can pick them by name.

sections.label: Hero — Split with eyebrow
sections.description: Two-column hero: eyebrow + headline + lede + primary/secondary CTA on the left; product shot or hero photo on the right. Works for SaaS landings, product launches, wellness apps.

sections.label: Features — 3-up icon grid
sections.description: Three feature cards in a single row (stacks to one column under 720px). Each card: emoji icon + heading + 1-2 sentence body. Universal — works on any website archetype.

sections.label: CTA — Centered banner
sections.description: Full-bleed banner with headline, lede, and a single primary CTA, centered. Strong call to convert. Use as the second-to-last section before the footer.
